verdict.rationale: Linear's 'Loops' feature lets users describe a recurring job in plain language and choose to run it on a schedule or in response to an event, and Linear Agent can build agents to monitor SLAs or investigate incidents—both are trigger-and-action style automations. However, this is agent/AI-driven rather than a classic native rule builder with granular conditions/actions, and deeper automation (e.g., issue field changes triggering actions) relies on webhooks/API/third-party integrations rather than an in-app no-code rule engine.
